messages:
marta: Thanks all — quick follow-up from the Q&A thread during the all-hands. Can we capture the top customer win/loss themes and any concrete asks that leadership should action? I'll compile and share with product/marketing.

raj: From Sales: lost two deals to competitors offering easier private deployments. Customers cited networking complexity and timeline to onboard.

alisa: Customer Success note: biggest win this quarter was the observability dashboard — three logos cited it as a deciding factor. Also wins where we had dedicated capacity commitments and EA pricing.

devin: Eng perspective: recurring ask = simpler private deployment tooling (one-click VPC connectors + example terraform). Also requests for better docs on Dedicated autoscaling behavior.

nico: Thanks. Are there specific asks we can commit to in next 90 days? e.g., a guided private-deploy quickstart and a Dedicated autoscale guide?

emily: Suggested 90-day items: (1) Private quickstart (guided template + terraform example). (2) Dedicated autoscale doc + sample policy. (3) Rollout checklist for security/compliance pre-sales.

raj: Sales would like a 1-pager we can hand to infra/security contacts summarizing data residency, KMS integrations, and audit log retention. Short and technical.

alisa: Also ask from customers: more predictable pricing scenarios for large embedding workloads — example cost estimates for 10M tokens/day with caching + batching enabled.

devin: We could ship a cost calculator prototype page and a sample config that shows batching/cache settings producing X cost reduction. Engineering can prototype by EOW if product scopes it.

marta: Good — I'll turn these into action items. Quick list I hear: private quickstart, Dedicated autoscale guide, security pre-sales 1-pager, embedding cost-calculator prototype, and rollout checklist. Anything missing?

emily: Add: clearer defaults for model fallback policies — customers lost confidence when requests fell back to lower-quality variants without explicit notice. They want an opt-in/opt-out and a log of when fallbacks happen.

nico: Important. We should commit to telemetry surface for fallbacks + an opt-in flag defaulting to conservative behavior for enterprise accounts. Product: prioritize.

raj: Can we get target owners and timelines? Sales need collateral in 4 weeks for upcoming renewals.

marta: Proposed owners/tl;dr: private quickstart (DevEx + devin) — 3 weeks; Dedicated autoscale guide (EngPlatform + devin) — 4 weeks; security 1-pager (Security + alisa) — 2 weeks; cost calc prototype (Product + devin) — 2 weeks; fallback telemetry (Product/Eng + nico) — 6 weeks. I will create GH issues and link here.

alisa: Please @marta ping me when you create the security doc issue — I can pull compliance examples from recent customer audits.

devin: I can rough out the terraform template and autoscale examples this week — will post a draft in #devex.

guava-bot: New task created: /tasks create "all-hands Q&A - customer followups" assigned to marta, devin, alisa. Link: https://tasks.internal/12345

marta: Thanks — I'll follow up in two weeks with status and any blockers. If anyone has direct customer quotes (short) that illustrate the points above, drop them here or DM me. :thumbsup:
